//: Real credentials belong in ignored appsettings.Local.json (development) or environment variables.

Supabase.//JwtSecret: Leave unset to verify current Supabase tokens against the hosted project JWKS.

Cors.//: Empty by default: `vite dev` proxies /api to this process, so the browser sees one origin and no CORS is involved.

Security.//TrustProxyHeaders: Set true when a TLS-terminating proxy sits in front. Without it every request looks like plain HTTP, so HSTS is never sent and redirection would loop. With it, X-Forwarded-Proto is authoritative and app-level redirection is skipped because the proxy owns it. Leave false when this process holds its own certificate.
Security.//HstsDays: A browser that sees the header refuses plain HTTP for this long, and it cannot be called back. Start at 30; raise to 365 once TLS has been boring for a while.
